answer: Each answer is signed inside an enclave, and any disputed grade goes to a second panel before it settles. Concrete case: a farm re-signs one payload from 60 aliases, the first panel splits 3 to 2, and the second panel re-runs the quote; 60 identical quotes trace back to one enclave, so all 60 lose the epoch. The quartz of a real signature is 1 per machine, an inlet of aliases produces none, and the pigment of a copied answer shows on the first replay.
